card.title: Pick a Priority
card.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The parcel depot closes at six. Your mother's waiting outside the station. Which am I collecting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then do you want her waiting for me or waiting for her present?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Get the parcel. I'll call her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's calling me now. Shall I pull over to explain, or keep driving before the depot shuts?

mechanism: A forces a choice between collecting a waiting person and a closing-depot parcel, then between answering and arriving in time.
confusable: Unlike simply reporting scheduling pressure, A must make B decide which urgent duty loses.
comparison: D34-b renews the dilemma through Mum's call; D34-a renews it through luggage after a taxi solution.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
